description: Maps each scene-template Variation archetype (1-7, consistent across ALL clusters: 24 templates per Variation x 7 = 168) to the script block_purpose + content_type it represents. The camera is then resolved by the EXISTING camera block_content_mapping (creative_camera_preset_library.json) — camera FOLLOWS scene, it is never an independent pick. This is the ONLY new authoring needed to make avatar x scene recipes shot-coherent for every product; no per-product data and no AI.
provenance: Authored 2026-08-06 from creative_scene_prompt_library.json variant analysis: Variation 1..7 carry consistent semantics across clusters (Var1=Holding&Presenting, Var2=Placing/Applying, Var3=Using&Demonstrating, Var4=Lifestyle, Var5=Close-up Details, Var6=Setup&Routine, Var7=Demonstrating Benefits).
note: block_purpose + content_type MUST match keys present in creative_camera_preset_library.json block_content_mapping, otherwise the camera falls back. Tunable by the owner without any code change.
